metadata.description: RoleModel Software's agent skills, one plugin per skill or per group of skills that depend on each other

plugins.name: make-it-right
plugins.description: The pass after code works: make-it-right, the optional make-it-fast pass, and made-it-wrong-retro, with their reviewer, tester, and verifier subagents.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Pick the top unresolved Sentry issue and run the full diagnose-and-fix workflow on it.

plugins.name: agentation
plugins.description: Add the Agentation visual feedback toolbar to a project so you can point at UI problems in the browser and hand them to an agent.

plugins.name: babysit-pr
plugins.description: Shepherd an open PR to mergeable — poll CI, verify review findings against the source, push fixes, rebase onto the base when needed.

plugins.name: bem-structure
plugins.description: CSS guidance using BEM (Block Element Modifier) methodology.

plugins.name: brave-breakdown
plugins.description: Interactive BRAVE framework thought partner for breaking down a Linear card before starting work.

plugins.name: cloudflare-tunnel
plugins.description: Expose locally-running apps to stable public HTTPS URLs with a single per-developer Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared).

plugins.name: create-pr
plugins.description: Open a pull request and assign the author, after showing the drafted title and body for approval.

plugins.name: dependabot-stack
plugins.description: Group all open Dependabot PRs on a repository into one ordered stack with `gh-stack`, so the week's dependency updates land as a single reviewable chain instead of N PRs that conflict on shared lockfiles.

plugins.name: document-this
plugins.description: Generate multi-audience documentation from any codebase — workflows for non-technical readers, architecture for developers, and AI orientation for agents.

plugins.name: dynamic-forms
plugins.description: Forms that change as they are filled in (dependent dropdowns, conditional fields, dynamic option lists) with the `turbo_form` gem, RoleModel's mechanism for dynamic form interaction.

plugins.name: feature-review
plugins.description: Review a commit, branch, or PR as a feature first and code second, on one self-contained HTML page.

plugins.name: generate-conventions
plugins.description: Fill an empty `docs/conventions/` with rules worth writing — taste calls, facts the code won't announce, and corrections that recur across past PR review comments — not what a survey of the codebase already tells you.

plugins.name: optics-context
plugins.description: RoleModel's Optics design system: components, `--op-` design tokens, and theming.

plugins.name: polymorphic-parent-resources
plugins.description: Serve a child resource that hangs off many different parents (comments, reports, duplications, attachments) from a single controller, using a route concern plus `resource_for` from `rolemodel_rails`.

plugins.name: rails-audit
plugins.description: Audit a whole Rails app against thoughtbot's best practices and write a markdown report grouped by category (Testing, Security, Models, Controllers, Code Design, Views) with severity levels.

plugins.name: rails-conventions
plugins.description: RoleModel's Rails conventions where they differ from what an agent writes by default: flash wording, `:unprocessable_content`, Simple Form for every form, `parent_resource.name.classify` in route concerns, and gotchas for `params.expect` with nested attributes and Lexxy change events.

plugins.name: ruby-version
plugins.description: Check which Ruby versions actually exist before claiming one does or doesn't, and install a specific Ruby through rbenv.

plugins.name: scaffold-docs
plugins.description: Install the agent-documentation structure in a project — a minimal `AGENTS.md`, a `docs/` tree with `CONVENTIONS.md` and `INDEX.md`, the convention-surfacing PreToolUse hook, and a symlinked `wrap-up`.

plugins.name: soft-destroyable
plugins.description: Soft-delete models with the `SoftDestroyable` concern from `rolemodel_rails` — `kept`/`only_deleted` instead of a default scope, cascading soft destroy and timestamp-matched restore, and the shared example.

plugins.name: split-stack
plugins.description: Split one PR that does too much into a stack of PRs, one per concern, without changing the combined diff.

plugins.name: standup-prep
plugins.description: Interview-style prep for a daily standup call.

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Test-driven development for Rails — outside-in with RSpec, Capybara, and FactoryBot.

plugins.name: trace
plugins.description: Trace a method, class, route, file, or snippet up to every real entry point and down to the data it touches, including calls made from inside installed packages.

plugins.name: turbo-modals
plugins.description: RoleModel's Turbo Frame modal and panel pattern from `rolemodel_rails`: `modal_link_to`, `render layout: 'modal'`, 422 on errors, redirect on success, and never the `layout` class method.

plugins.name: ux-review
plugins.description: Review UI code against Nielsen's 10 heuristics and the Laws of UX, reported as a severity-ranked issue log with file-and-line evidence and Optics-based fixes.

plugins.name: wrap-up
plugins.description: End a work session by routing what was learned into the right doc layer — convention, subsystem, guide, or architecture — and pruning what the session proved stale.
